stem: If aerobic respiration does not occur, why must NADH be reoxidized to NAD+?

options.label: A
options.text: ATP synthase consumes NADH as its substrate
options.misconception: ATP synthase uses ADP+Pi and proton flow.
options.explanation: NADH feeds the ETC when available.

options.label: B
options.text: Oxygen can oxidize glucose without any carriers
options.misconception: Oxygen is not a direct glycolytic oxidant.

options.label: C
options.text: NADH must become NADPH for biosynthesis only
options.explanation: The issue is NAD+ availability for GAPDH.

options.label: D
options.text: NAD+ is needed only to build glycogen stores

options.label: E
options.text: NAD+ must be regenerated as an electron carrier
options.misconception: None; NAD+ is needed when the ETC is unavailable.
options.explanation: OpenStax: NADH must be reoxidized to NAD+ for reuse as an electron carrier so glycolysis can continue.

context: Learning objective: fermentation regenerates NAD+ for glycolysis.
